    • runQuery

      public ATPResult runQuery(KB kb, String userSessionId, String query, String testFilePath, String runSource, String proverType, String language, String vampireMode, boolean closedWorldAssumption, boolean modusPonens, boolean dropOnePremise, boolean holUseModals, int timeout, int maxAnswers)
      Runs the primary ask API without requiring an ATPQuery object.
      Parameters:
      kb - knowledge base to query.
      userSessionId - user session identifier.
      query - query to send to the prover.
      testFilePath - path to the test file, if applicable.
      runSource - source of the run.
      proverType - prover to use.
      language - target logical language.
      vampireMode - Vampire execution mode.
      closedWorldAssumption - whether to use the closed world assumption.
      modusPonens - whether to enable modus ponens.
      dropOnePremise - whether to drop one premise during inference.
      holUseModals - whether HOL modal translation is enabled.
      timeout - prover timeout in seconds.
      maxAnswers - maximum number of answers to return.
      Returns:
      result object for the query.
